entities.summary: Magdalena Álvarez Arza is a Spanish politician. From 2004 to 2009, she served as Minister of Public Works (Fomento). She is an MP for the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) for Málaga Province. Previously, she was the Minister for the Economy in the Junta de Andalucía.
